tagline: Connect Asana project management with Notion documentation
metaTitle: Asana + Notion Integration: Project Briefs in Notion
metaDescription: Send Asana project briefs and milestone docs to Notion and show live task status there. GAIA keeps plans and documentation in one place. See the setup steps.
intro: Asana tracks the work. Notion holds the context. Most teams use them in isolation, leading to project documentation that doesn't reflect current task status and task lists that lack the strategic context needed to prioritize correctly. GAIA creates a live connection between them.

useCases.title: Project briefs from Asana to Notion
useCases.description: When a new project is created, GAIA generates a corresponding brief page with goals, stakeholders, and timeline extracted from the project description.

useCases.title: Milestone documentation
useCases.description: When milestones are reached, GAIA creates documentation entries capturing what was delivered, decisions made, and lessons learned.

useCases.title: Asana task status in Notion
useCases.description: Project pages show live task completion percentages, giving stakeholders project health visibility in the tool they already use.

useCases.title: Project retrospective generation
useCases.description: At project completion, GAIA compiles task history into a structured retrospective template covering what went well, what didn't, and key learnings.

useCases.title: Resource documentation sync
useCases.description: Files and documents linked in tasks are automatically referenced in the corresponding project page, creating a unified resource hub.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your workspace and account. Select which projects to sync.
Define which Notion section receives documentation for each Asana project or project type. GAIA handles all the content creation and updates.
As project status evolves, the documentation stays current automatically. Your knowledge base reflects project reality without manual maintenance.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync custom fields to database properties?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom fields (like budget, client name, or phase) map to database properties, preserving all project metadata in your knowledge base.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with Asana portfolios?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can create pages for portfolios that aggregate status across all included projects, giving leadership a portfolio-level view in the documentation space.

faqs.question: Can Notion documents link back to the source tasks?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA includes the task or project URL in every entry it creates, so readers can navigate directly to the source for full task history.
